behavioral_effects: None stated. An empty list is a claim that nothing observably changes.
compatibility_impact: No runtime behavior changes. Operators who already placed a key at the old MANUAL_STEPS.md path keep working by setting GOOGLE_DRIVE_CREDENTIALS_FILE explicitly, which the updated doc still describes. Files already tracked by git are unaffected by ignore rules, and none exist under the ignored paths.
reason: Ahead of making the repository public: nothing prevented a real service-account key from being committed - neither secrets/ nor credentials/ appears in .gitignore even though the documented setup writes a Google Drive JSON key to those paths, and backend/.dockerignore would let a key at backend/credentials/ be baked into the image build context. MANUAL_STEPS.md also tells the operator to save the key to secrets/gdrive-service-account.json while the settings default and every other doc use credentials/google-drive-sa.json, so the two paths are unified on the settings default.
rollback: git revert the single commit; ignore rules and the doc line return to their prior state. No data or schema involved.
security_impact: Prevents secret material from ever being committed or baked into an image: secrets/ and credentials/ (at any depth) are now gitignored, and both Docker build contexts (backend/, frontend/) exclude secrets/, credentials/, and *.pem via their .dockerignore files. No tracked file currently lives under either directory (verified with git ls-files), so this is purely preventive. The documented Google Drive service-account path is unified on the settings default credentials/google-drive-sa.json - MANUAL_STEPS.md previously pointed operators at secrets/gdrive-service-account.json, a path nothing else used and nothing ignored.
summary: Ignore secrets/ and credentials/ in git and Docker build contexts and standardize the Google Drive service-account path
